response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with nearly 20 years of development experience and genuine developer-tooling interests (test runners, assertion libraries, CI infrastructure, workshops). However, this is a Level II engineering management role requiring at least 2 years of formal people management and 3 years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of people management, performance reviews, roadmap ownership for a team, or leading organizational change. Mobile experience is limited to a single iOS/Apple TV stint a decade ago, and there is no advanced degree. The profile fits a senior/staff IC track far better than this management role.
strengths: Deep, broad software development experience (18+ years) exceeding the 8-year minimum
Authentic developer-tools background: test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD setup, test automation courses, MCP code generators
Mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, coding dojos, and conference talks
concerns: No formal people management experience (no direct reports, 1:1s, or performance management evident)
No demonstrated organizational-change leadership or team roadmap ownership
Mobile platform experience is thin and dated (2015-2016 iOS work only)

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
